title: Cached contract of one definition, stored at .review-cache/contracts/<key>.json

key.description: node.contract.key: hash of this definition's fingerprint and its callees' fingerprints.

partial.description: True when a callee is reached by dynamic dispatch. A partial contract never supports lowering a level.

inputs.description: Parameters and the instance or global state read.

assumes.description: What callers must guarantee. This is what the `up` direction checks.
